name: The Veritate
source: In this visual novel, you will be in the role of a typical young guy who is lucky enough to live together with a couple of beautiful girls. But things may not be as tempting as they may seem at first glance. You will have to make very difficult choices and crucial decisions. You're in for a great deal of entertaining life situations and interesting moments.​
translation: 在这部视觉小说中，你将扮演一个典型的年轻人的角色，他很幸运能够与几个漂亮的女孩住在一起。但事情可能并不像乍看起来那么诱人。你将不得不做出非常困难的选择和关键的决定。你会遇到很多有趣的生活情境和有趣的时刻。​
